title: optionsframe
summary: MSUI intentionally retains the build-5875 Game Menu and resizable OptionsFrame shape rather than Benilla's era category-tree shell. Its GameMenuUiLaw now owns fixed/resizable size, viewport clamping and modal centering. Video, Interface and Sound pages live-apply persisted settings; Sound exposes master/effects/music/ambience gates and vanilla volume defaults, Interface exposes the current Player/NPC/Own nameplate rows wired into the renderer, and every page has a page-scoped Defaults action. Settings search remains absent.

openItems.text: No Sound/Audio options page - the Game Menu's Sound Options button is permanently disabled ('no sound subsystem yet', a stale claim now that PlayUiSound exists) despite UI sounds being live
openItems.resolution: The Game Menu's Sound Options button is enabled and opens a live page with Enable All/Music/Ambience switches plus Master, Effects, Music and Ambience volume sliders backed by persisted AudioSettings and applied through the live audio mixer path.

openItems.text: No nameplate options rows (Benilla's Nameplates page: show friendly/enemy plates etc.)
openItems.resolution: Interface Options now exposes Player Names, NPC Names and Show Own Name rows with current Benilla's enabled defaults; the persisted ControlSettings flags gate the live nameplate candidate pass.

Every options page footer has a Defaults button. ResetVisiblePageToDefaults replaces only the visible page's settings group (Video composites, Controls including nameplates, or Audio), resolves composites, and applies the result live.

openItems.text: No per-page Defaults button (only whole-quality presets)
